title: Natural Meal
summary: Eat a real meal your own way for about nine minutes.
purpose: Capture real bout lengths, pauses, talking and drinking during a meal. Periods are not instructions about chewing; every chewing span is labelled afterwards from video and motion proposals.

request.summary: No natural, uninstructed meal exists; guided takes cannot show real pauses, conversation or pace changes.

preparation: Wear both AirPods and confirm they are connected to this iPhone.
Prop the iPhone so your face and jaw stay visible while you eat.
Use steady, even lighting on your face.
Serve a normal meal; talking, pausing and drinking are all fine.
If the meal ends early, keep sitting until the recording finishes.

camera.position: Prop the iPhone upright at face height, about an arm's length away, front camera facing you with face and jaw visible.

activities.instruction: Look at the camera and nod distinctly
activities.expected_behavior: One clear nod visible in video and AirPods motion; mouth still

activities.instruction: Eat your meal as you normally would
activities.detail: Chew, pause, talk or drink whenever you like. Nothing here is a label; chewing is marked afterwards.
activities.expected_behavior: Natural eating with pauses; any mix of chewing, talking, drinking and rest
Natural eating with pauses; any mix of chewing, talking, drinking and rest

activities.instruction: Keep eating naturally, or sit and relax if you are done
activities.expected_behavior: Natural eating, finishing, or resting after the meal
